goal.objective: Activate the canonical StegVerse single-heartbeat runtime continuously on a StegVerse-owned or StegVerse-federated node using only node-local durable storage and native process supervision; third-party platforms may mirror source or validation evidence but cannot be required for deployment, scheduling, liveness, recovery, or worker leasing.
success_predicates: A StegVerse-owned or StegVerse-federated continuous carrier runs the canonical runtime
The carrier starts from already-present local runtime source or a StegVerse-distributed capsule without provider fetch dependency
Heartbeat, registry, event, cost, receipt, worker-coordination and canonical-checkpoint state survive carrier restart/replacement
Runtime v9 owns internal heartbeat cadence and carries worker-coordination subsignals every cycle
Worker lease lifetime is measured in canonical heartbeat cycles
Restart/replacement continuity preserves or increments the heartbeat epoch and creates no duplicate claim or fence
No external scheduler or process host owns worker activation
failure_predicates: Any third-party platform is treated as a required production dependency
A provider outage or quota is treated as a production activation blocker
A stateless or sleeping carrier is presented as durable activation without reconstructable state
A third-party scheduler becomes heartbeat cadence or worker activation authority
Carrier restart loses or forks canonical state

task.derivation_reason: Production activation must be StegVerse-native; unfinished work must be heartbeat-worker managed rather than chat-owned.

activation.recheck_trigger: each admitted heartbeat until node-local activation.latest.json proves all nine sovereign runtime predicates

completion.next_authorized_action: Heartbeat worker rechecks node-local sovereign activation evidence every admitted cycle; when a StegVerse sovereign node emits all nine predicates true, the worker completes and Master Records reconstruction finalizes the task.
terminal_when: A continuously executing canonical heartbeat carrier is active on a StegVerse-owned/federated node
Master Records reconstruction restores canonical state after restart/replacement
StegVerse-Labs/.github#12 sovereign activation predicates are all satisfied

block.machine_observable_release_condition: node-local activation.latest.json reports all nine sovereign runtime predicates true
